translations.web: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
translations.bsb: The fear of man is a snare, but whoever trusts in the LORD is set securely on high.
translations.kjv: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
translations.asv: The fear of man bringeth a snare; But whoso putteth his trust in Jehovah shall be safe.
